sentences.japanese: やっと、マリオさんが姫さまの愛を勝ち得ることができた。
sentences.english: At last, Mario managed to win the princess's love.

sentences.japanese: うるさいなっ！少しの頭痛くらい我慢しろ。余は魔力がすっからかんだ。それもこれも姫のせいだぞ。
sentences.english: Shurrup! Don't make such a fuss over a little headache. I'm flat out of magical power - this is all your fault!

sentences.japanese: 姫は目を閉じて、横たわっておられた。
sentences.english: The princess lay with her eyes closed.

sentences.japanese: 姫は帝に赦しを乞うた。
sentences.english: The princess begged forgiveness from the emperor.

sentences.japanese: お姫さま、おはようございます。
